title: Style Analysis
description:
Prerequisite: MUSC251; and permission of ARHU-School of Music department.
Restriction: Must not have completed MUSC448.
Credit only granted for: MUSC673, MUSC448F, or MUSC699F.
Formerly: MUSC699F. An analytical study of musical style from the Middle Ages to present through analysis of selected compositions. The principle genres and composers of Medieval, Renaissance, Baroque, Classical, Romantic and 20th century music will be covered.
